crossRefs.note: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness…

translations.web: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.
translations.bsb: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels that go down into the inmost being.
translations.kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
translations.asv: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts.
